title: Spiritual Gifts
summary: Spiritual Gifts is a theological doctrine that traces the Spirit's presence, power, and new-covenant life across Scripture.
historical_context: Spiritual Gifts is read across the canon as Scripture develops this theme from Israel's story into the New Testament witness.
ancient_near_east_context: Ancient covenant, royal, wisdom, and temple backgrounds provide comparison points, but Scripture gives the topic its own theological shape.
literary_context: The topic appears in narrative, poetry, prophecy, Gospel, epistle, and apocalyptic writing as context requires.
covenantal_significance: Spiritual Gifts helps show how covenant promises are stated, tested, and fulfilled in Scripture.
interpretive_notes: Read Spiritual Gifts in its immediate context before generalizing.
